extracted.intended_audience: writers applying to the Stanford Stegner Fellowship (fiction and poetry)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for preparing and submitting application materials for the Stanford Stegner Fellowship, including required statements, recommenders, and a writing sample, with genre-specific length limits. Targets prospective fiction and poetry applicants for a two-year workshop fellowship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal background information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the required application materials; no further details provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommenders (contact information for 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information for 2 recommenders who can speak to your suitability as a workshop participant (please do not submit letters of recommendation)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must provide contact information only for two recommenders. Recommenders should be able to speak to the applicant's suitability as a workshop participant. Do not submit actual letters of recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of plans (1000 words max)
rubrics_metrics.description: A statement of plans in which you briefly explain your writing plans for the two years of the Stegner Fellowship (1000 words maximum)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe intended writing projects and goals for the fellowship period; keep the statement concise and within the 1,000-word limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshop expectations & contribution statement (300 words max)
rubrics_metrics.description: A description of what you hope to get out of the workshops in your genre and how you intend to contribute to the development of other Fellows’ work (300 words maximum)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address both what you expect to learn/receive from workshops and how you will contribute to peers' development; adhere to the 300-word maximum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing sample (fiction: 9,000 words max; poetry: 15 pages max)
rubrics_metrics.description: A writing sample (9000 words maximum for fiction, 15 pages maximum for poetry)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a representative sample of your work in the appropriate genre. Respect the distinct length limits by genre: up to 9,000 words for fiction submissions; up to 15 pages for poetry submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application fee and fee waiver
rubrics_metrics.description: The application fee is $55, payable by credit or debit card. A fee waiver is available for those who qualify; the fee waiver request form is integrated into the online application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan to pay the $55 fee by card unless eligible for a waiver. If eligible, request the fee waiver through the integrated form in the online application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online application submission & deadlines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted via the program's online application system. Note posted cohort status (e.g., applications for the 2026–2028 cohort are closed; next round opens September 1). Check deadlines and open/closed status before preparing materials.
